name: Animation
description: Author step-based animations for technical explainer diagrams
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.changelog:
1.1.1: Animations embed inline in the agent transcript, and exports finish and reveal the exported file.
1.1.0: Frames can show real product UI: an html part draws markup you write inline or keep in a file beside the animation, regions inside it animate on their own, and the document names the palette it renders under so the stage and every export match.
marketplace.tagline: Animate technical diagrams step by step
marketplace.longDescription: Build animated explainer diagrams from a named scene and an ordered list of steps. Scrub the timeline, drag a step boundary to retime it, click any part of the scene to put it in chat context, and let an agent make the edits.
highlights: Steps and states rather than a keyframe dope sheet
Click any part to hand it to the agent with its state and time
Plain JSON on disk, so any agent can edit it without special tools

screenshots.alt: Animation editor showing a cache-aside read path, with the step strip and timeline below the stage

claudePlugin.description: Authoring guidance for step-based animated explainer diagrams
